video_title: Keegan Murray says Sacramento Kings' offense hasn't been good enough this season

quotes.speaker: Keegan Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Keegan Murray on finding his rhythm after inconsistent playing time
quotes.excerpt: it takes a couple games obviously to get in a rhythm
quotes.quote: It takes a couple games obviously to get in a rhythm. Especially last year I was in and out of the lineup, so the more games I put together, the better I feel and I feel like I'm moving pretty good, so I'm just happy with how I'm feeling right now.

quotes.speaker: Keegan Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Keegan Murray on building chemistry with De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: I think we can be really good
quotes.quote: I think we can be really good. There's times where I feel like we could switch off depending on who we're guarding and things like that. Obviously it takes time to build chemistry, but we have a good relationship off the court. On the court we haven't had much time together and I think the more that we get to play with each other, the better it will be.

quotes.speaker: Keegan Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Keegan Murray on the Kings' offensive struggles and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: we haven't been scoring the ball well at times
quotes.quote: It's a bit difficult. We just have a lot of guys that can put the ball in the basket and what really good teams do is they find a chemistry, they find times where guys are going and they keep going to them. It's something we have to work on. We haven't been scoring the ball well at times and I feel like we have a team that can score the ball with anyone, we just haven't done it at all this year.

quotes.speaker: Keegan Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Keegan Murray on maintaining motivation during a difficult season
quotes.excerpt: at the end of the day you have to find something to motivate you
quotes.quote: Obviously it's tough being 1-11. It's tough in the locker room, but at the end of the day you have to find something to motivate you to be able to go out there and win games. It's a long season and I know from experience we've gone on losing streaks, but I've been on teams where you win one game and you can string together a couple in a row. Right now we haven't won much and that's not a good feeling, so we have to figure out how to win games.

quotes.speaker: Keegan Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Keegan Murray on self-motivation and the Kings' home crowd
quotes.excerpt: I feel like the fans deserve a lot better than this
quotes.quote: For me, it's the fans. I've been here when it's been really good. I feel like the fans deserve a lot better than this and I think for everyone at this point it's self-motivation. It's not motivation within the team, you have to find something within yourself to better the team. We have one of the best fan bases in the world and they show out every night, they showed out tonight and we have to be better for them.

quotes.speaker: Keegan Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Keegan Murray on the need for better shot selection
quotes.excerpt: we take a lot of tough shots
quotes.quote: We have to find easier looks. I feel like we take a lot of tough shots and for Portland for example, they're really good at drive, kick, swinging and catching and shooting and things like that and that makes the game easy for a lot of guys. When we're able to get clean looks, we're able to knock down shots. It's tough to make a bunch of tough shots throughout the course of 48 minutes, so that's where the good teams and the great teams are separated.

quotes.speaker: Keegan Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Keegan Murray on defensive progress and transition scoring
quotes.quote: I feel like the last three games we've been good defensively, just being able to follow the game plan and things like that. Getting on transition, especially tonight, I feel like we got a lot of transition looks in the fourth quarter on the breakaway. We've been playing good defense, we just have to figure out how to score the ball.

quotes.speaker: Keegan Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Keegan Murray on the team's long-term outlook
quotes.excerpt: we know that Rome's not built in a day
quotes.quote: It's obviously tough on them, but just keep supporting. I feel like for me, I love our fans, they've been great to us, they've been great to me and I obviously appreciate them coming out and supporting. We know that Rome's not built in a day, but at the end of the day we're trying and with their support it'll only get better. They've been great to us so far and we just have to keep putting our front foot forward, playing hard and trying to win some games.

quotes.speaker: Keegan Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Keegan Murray on mentoring rookie teammate Darius
quotes.excerpt: when we're really good, this place is better than any arena in the NBA
quotes.quote: I've told a lot of our guys, because I'm one of the few guys that have been here when we've been really good, and I tell them all the time, when we're really good, this place is better than any arena in the NBA. I feel like that's a big motivating factor in what we're trying to get to. Darius is going to have games where it's tough on him, but I feel like he's got a good head on his shoulders and I'm hopeful that we can get back on track.
